profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap point in Porto San Giorgio, on Italy's Adriatic coast, tagged telecom=data_center, is named Studio BETA SRLS. "SRLS" is the Italian legal designation for a simplified limited-liability company, a structure commonly used by small startups, freelancers, and professional practices due to its lower minimum capital requirements, and "Studio" again indicates a professional-services or design practice in Italian usage. As with the similarly named Studio Delta Srl record elsewhere in this dataset, this pattern points to a small office rather than a data-center business. This entry documents the likely mistag rather than fabricating data-center specifications for what is, by its own name, a small professional-services firm.

reading.body:
Studio BETA SRLS in Porto San Giorgio, Italy is tagged as a data center in OpenStreetMap but is almost certainly a small professional-services office, not infrastructure for AI compute.

The entry exists because OpenStreetMap contributors mistagged a location. The name itself signals the error. SRLS is the Italian legal form for simplified limited-liability companies, typically chosen by small startups and professionals to minimize capital requirements. Studio is Italian for office or practice, used for design firms and consultancies, not data-center operators. A facility with this structure and naming would have zero megawatts of power capacity, making it invisible to AI infrastructure planning.

This matters because data quality on infrastructure location matters downstream. If datasets conflate small professional offices with actual data centers, maps of compute availability become noise. Someone planning where to build an AI facility or route power to one cannot rely on counts that include mistagged entries.

The record does not reveal how many similar mistags exist in OpenStreetMap's telecom=data_center category, or whether they cluster in particular regions. It documents one false positive but leaves the scope of the problem unknown.
